caption:
Try this: sort your spending into 3 buckets. 🧮

1. Must pay (rent, utilities, food, insurance)
2. Should save (emergency fund, debt payoff)
3. Nice to have

If bucket 1 eats most of your pay, that's where to look first. Which bucket is biggest for you?
first_comment: Which bucket is biggest for you: 1, 2 or 3? 👇
